content: Pauro mumugye gwa Koriinto
Hano amangʼana gayo gahwiiri, Pauro akatanura kurwa Atene hayo, akagya mumugye gwa Koriinto.

Akasikana no Omuyahudi wumwe, eriina ryaaye ni Akiira, omwiibhurwa wa Poonto. Akiira hamwe no omukari waaye Prisika, bhaari bhararwa mumugye gwa Rooma mukyaaro kya Itaria. Bhakarwa eyo kwo okubha Kaisari Kiraudio
yaari aswaagirye kubha Abhayahudi bhoosi bharwe mumugye muyo. Kweego Pauro akagya kukeerya Akiira no omukari waaye.
Na kwo okubha Pauro ewe yaari arakora emirimo gyo okutuma amatuundubhaari kye ebho, akiikara owaabhu bhakabha bharakora emirimo giyo kwa hamwe.

Eziisiku zyoosi zyo okumuunya, Pauro yaari arasikira munyuumba ye esaango ya Abhayahudi, akabha arabharwaazira Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu. Yaari arasakya kukorokoomba Abhayahudi na abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi.
Hano Siira na Timoteo bhaahikiri hayo okurwa Makedonia, Pauro akaruusya eriibhaga ryaaye ryoosi areegya engʼana ya Taatabhugya ku Abhayahudi kwo okubhakumiirirya kubha, Yeesu niwe Masiya.

Nawe Abhayahudi bhayo bhakataanga kumuhakania no okumutuka. Amangʼana gayo gakagirya akabhakungʼuutira oruteeri runo rwaari rugiiri kumyeenda gyaaye, na akabhabhuurira, “Amanyiinga geenyu gabhe iguru weenyu abheene! Enye, nitana engʼana yino nimusariirye. Kweema bhoono, nirabha niragya mubhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi.”
Kyaamwe Pauro akahuruka kurwa munyuumba ye esaango, akasikira munyuumba yino yaari embarika waaye. Enyuumba yiyo yaari ya Tito Yusito, omuutu wuno yaari akumuseengera Taatabhugya.

Omukaangati we enyuumba ye esaango yiyo, eriina ryaaye Kirisipo, woosi akamwiikirirya Omukuru Yeesu, hamwe na abhaatu bhoosi munyuumba yaaye. Abhakoriinto abhaandi bhaaru bhano bhakiigwa amangʼana ga Pauro, nabho bhakiikirirya, bhakabatiizwa.
Orusiku rumwe obhutiku, Omukuru akamubhuurira Pauro mubhurori, “Otoobhoha, ogeenderere ego kurwaaza, otakira.
Enye niri hamwe na naawe, na atariho omuutu wuyo woosi wuno araakunyahaare no okukora kibhi, kwo okubha abhaatu bhaaru bha mumugye muno bharaaza kuniikyoorera.”
Pauro akiikara Koriinto hayo, kwa mwaaka gumwe ne emyeeri esaasabha, areegya abhaatu engʼana ya Taatabhugya.
Hano Gario yaari omwaanaangwa we ekyaaro kya Akaaya, Abhayahudi bhoosi kwa hamwe bhakamutuumira Pauro. Bhakamureeta embere we ekituumbi kyo okutinira ekiina,
no okumuzoongera kwo okubhuga, “Omuutu wuno arabhuurira abhaatu bhabhe bharamuseengera Taatabhugya kwe enzira eyiindi yino etakweenderwa ne emigiro gyeetu.”

Hano Pauro yeendiri kugaamba iguru waaye, Gario akabhabhuurira Abhayahudi bhayo, “Emwe Abhayahudi, yiingabheeri mumuzoongeeri omuutu wuno iguru yo okusarya emigiro gye Ekirooma, niho ningabhiitegeereeri.
Nawe kwo okurora haka ezyeene iguru wa amangʼana, amariina ne emigiro gyeenyu, mugamare emwe abheene. Enye nitakweenda kubha omutaania wa amangʼana gano.”
Niho Gario akaswaagya kubha bhaheebhwe okurwa mwiibaraza.
Neebho bhoosi bhakamugwaata Sositenesi wuno yaari omukaangati we enyuumba ye esaango, bhakamutemera haryaharya mwiibaraza. Nawe Gario ataagiiri nago mitwe naabhe hasuuhu.
Pauro arakyoora mumugye gwa Antiokia ya Siria
Pauro akageenderera kwiikara mumugye gwa Koriinto kwa siku nzaru, okumara akaraga abhiikirirya abharikyaaye bha hayo. Akagya mumugye gwa Kenikirea, akamwa omutwe gwaaye
kwo obhwiirahiri bhuno yaari aragiri. Kimwe ewe, Prisika na Akiira bhakatiira mumeeri bhakagya hamwe mukyaaro kya Siria.
Hano bhaahikiri mumugye gwa Efeso, Pauro yabhatigiri Prisika na Akiira. Ewe akasikira munyuumba ye esaango, akabha arakeerenia na Abhayahudi.
Abhayahudi bhayo bhakamusabha Pauro kubha yoongerye eziisiku zino araatame owaabhu hayo, nawe Pauro ateendiri.
Nawe hano yatanwiiri, akaraga, “Hano Taatabhugya araaseege, nirakyoora kweeki oweenyu hano.” Niho Pauro akatanura Efeso hayo kwe emeeri.
Emeeri ekiimeerera kumwaambuko gwo omugye gwa Kaisaria, Pauro ewe akatiira kugya mumugye gwa Yerusaremu, kukeerya abhaatu bhe ekanisa. Okumara akahiriingita mumugye gwa Antiokia.
Hano yaari yiikeeri Antiokia kwe eziisiku suuhu, akatanura kurwa eyo akabha arahita mumugye gwa Garatia tee Furigia, na yaari arabhoongera amanaga kwo okubhagumiirirya abhaanabheega bhoosi.
Apooro arataanga emirimo gyaaye

Kwe eriibhaga riyo, akaaza Omuyahudi wumwe mumugye gwa Efeso, eriina ryaaye ni Apooro, omwiibhurwa wa Arekizandiria. Ewe yaari muutu wo obhunagya bhukuru bhwo okugaamba, na mukaari wo okusoma Amakaamo Amahoreeru.

Omuutu wuyo yaari yeegiibhwe enzira yo Omukuru, neewe yaari no omukya gwo obhuheene na yaari arabheegya abhaatu kwo obhukaari na kwo obhuheene iguru wa Yeesu, yiingabha yaari amenyiri iguru wo obhubatiizo bhwa Yohana omweene.

Apooro akasikira munyuumba ye esaango ya Abhayahudi, akataanga okweegya muyo kwo obhukaari. Hano Prisika na Akiira bhiigwiiri ameegyo ga Apooro gayo, bhakamuginihya owaabhu, bhakamubhuurira obhuheene bhwe enzira ya Taatabhugya kyeego eri.

Hano Apooro yeendiri kugya mukyaaro kya Akaaya, abhiikirirya bha Efeso bhakamutoongera ekoro agye eyo, bhakamukaamira enyaarubha yo okumumenyeekererya kubhaanabheega bhe eyo. Hano yahikiri eyo, akabhasakirya abhaatu bhano bhaamwiikiriirye Yeesu kurubhaango rwa Taatabhugya.
Apooro yaari arahakana na Abhayahudi embere wa abhaatu bhoosi kwo obhukaari, kwo okubheerekeererya kwo obhweero mu Makaamo Amahoreeru kubha Yeesu niwe Masiya.

footnotes.text: Kaisari Kiraudio yaari omutemi omukuru wa Abharooma.
Abhayahudi hano bhaari bhamariri okukora amangʼana gano bhatuuriri obhwiirahiri ku Taatabhugya, bhaari bharamwa eziinzweeri mumitwe okweerekya obhwiirahiri bhuyo bhukorwe.
